description:
Job Title: CRM Developer 
 Location: Redmond, WA 
 Duration: Full Time and Contract 
 
 Experienced in developing and maintaining MS Dynamics CRM 2016 business solutions with 2+ years of experience.
 Experienced configuring the application to meet a client’s requirements using the Microsoft Dynamics CRM Customization Tool, Workflow Tool, or SDK
 Demonstrated experience in developing Workflows, Custom Workflow, Plug-ins and Form based customizations within Dynamics CRM
 Experience working with JavaScript as well as SharePoint 
 Good to have experience in C# or other relevant programming language.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
